title: If medical officers or medical attendants
text:
90.

If medical officers or medical attendants
are not carried on [a special trade
passenger ship] as required by sub-section
(1) or sub-section (2) of section 259 as the
case may be; or if the ship is not provided
with a hospital, medical stores and
equipment as required by sub-section (3)
of that section.

248(1) The master, owner or agent
shall be liable to fine which
may extend to two thousand
rupees.

249 Fine which may extend to
one thousand rupees.

252 Fine which may extend to
one thousand rupees.

255(1) Fine which may extend to
two hundred rupees

255(6) Fine which may extend to
two thousand rupees.]

259 The master, owner or agent
shall be liable for each
voyage made in

contravention of section 259
to fine winch may extend to
five hundred rupees.

259(4)(a) The master, owner or agent
shall be liable for each
voyage made in

contravention of clause (a)
of sub-section (4) of section
259 to fine which may
extend to three hundred
rupees.

259(4)(c) fine which may extend to
two hundred rupees.]

260 Fine which may extend to
one thousand rupees.

3[90A. (a) If medical officers and attendants are

not carried on a pilgrim ship in
accordance with clause (a) of subsection (4) section 259; or

(b) If a medical officer or attendant or a
pilgrim ship contravenes clause (c) of subsection (4) of section 259.
